cell_id.description: Run from the first cell through this one, by id

cell_index.description: Run from the first cell through this one, by 0-based index, for cells without ids

python.description: The interpreter to use. Default: .venv or venv in the working directory, else python3

timeout.description: How long the whole run may take, in milliseconds. Default 300000

run_outside_sandbox.description: Ask the user to run it outside the OS sandbox. Only after the sandbox refused it

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
